Name: Chilion, Son of Elimelech
Summary: Chilion, son of Elimelech and Naomi, died in Moab after marrying Orpah.
KeyStory: Chilion went with his family to Moab, married Orpah, and died there with his brother, leaving Naomi widowed and childless.
RelatedPeople: Elimelech; Naomi; Orpah; Mahlon, Son of Elimelech
LifeLesson: Two brothers, two Moabite wives, two early graves — and Naomi left alone.
